verdict.line: You lose if you walk into her Snip Snip cone and trade autos at range, but you win skirmishes once you land a full Q-W-E stun chain while her Hallowed Mist and Skip 'n Slash are both down.

brief.thesis: Riven's Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) stun into E (Valor) gap-close beats Gwen in a committed fight, but Gwen's Snip Snip cone and Hallowed Mist let her pick when that fight happens. The matchup sits at 49.6% over 409 games because the winner is whoever dictates engagement timing, not whoever has more raw damage.

theirWindow.when: Snip Snip and Skip 'n Slash both ready
theirWindow.what: She can poke you down with up to 6 snips (true damage on the center hit, healing her via A Thousand Cuts) and then dash away with Skip 'n Slash before you can punish. Don't walk forward to trade here — let the poke land on minions or disengage.

yourWindow.when: Her W and E both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Engage immediately with Broken Wings into Ki Burst to stun her, then use Valor's damage block to eat any remaining Snip Snip ticks. She has no Hallowed Mist to vanish into and no Skip 'n Slash to dash away, so the fight is yours to finish.

start.why: Picked in 93.9% of games (48.7% WR over 464 games) — the extra sustain and AD let you trade autos into Thousand Cuts procs without losing the lane outright.

boots.why: 65.4% pick rate, 43.8% WR over 308 games — the ability haste tightens your Q-W-E cycle and gets Valor back faster so you can dodge a second Snip Snip volley sooner.

core.why: Lead item on the top build path (54.1% WR, 19.4% pick) — cuts Blade of Exile's cooldown so your Wind Slash execute comes online more than once a fight.
Second item in the same path — sustain and damage to outlast her passive's healing on prolonged trades.
Closes out the most-run path — heals back a portion of the damage from her Snip Snip and Needlework hits and delays burst long enough to land your own.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through your auto-attacks and ability hits during the Q-W-E combo, giving you sustain in extended trades that offsets the healing Gwen gets from A Thousand Cuts.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 94.9% of games at 50.1% WR — Ignite punishes Gwen before her passive healing and Death's Dance-style sustain ramp up, and secures kills out of your Q-W-E all-in window.

playing.title: Dodge Snip Snip with Valor
playing.detail: Save E (Valor)'s damage block for when she fires Snip Snip rather than burning it to poke — it blocks incoming damage while you close distance, erasing most of the volley's value.

playing.title: All-in before Hallowed Mist is up
playing.detail: Track her W cooldown (22/21/20/19/18s). If it's down, she has no way to make herself untargetable — force your Q-W-E stun chain in that window instead of when she can vanish into the mist.

playing.title: Punish a used Skip 'n Slash
playing.detail: Her E (13-11s cooldown) both closes gaps and buffs her attack speed and range. If she's just used it to poke or reposition, she can't dash away from your engage.

playing.title: Hold Wind Slash for the finish
playing.detail: From level 6 on, don't fire R's Wind Slash on reflex — it's a single-use ranged attack, so hold it for when she tries to walk away low rather than wasting it mid-combo.

playing.title: Weave autos through Runic Blade
playing.detail: Your passive charges from Q, W, and E uses add damage to your next basic attack — land an auto between each ability press in your combo so you don't waste charges.

playing.title: Don't facetank her passive procs
playing.detail: Snip Snip's center hit deals true damage and triggers A Thousand Cuts, healing her on subsequent champion hits. If you can't force a fast kill, disengage rather than trading auto-for-auto.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, sample sizes, and the build/rune/summoner options above are measured from current-patch games (409 head-to-head); the cooldown-window reads and trade-pattern advice are my own tactical analysis.
